title: Shallow lunar craters with a hard convex floor

tellings.quote: the craters on the moon are all only a few miles deep. You never find a crater on the moon that's more than five or six miles deep.

plain: A philosopher named Jason Jorjani says on a podcast that craters on the Moon are all only a few miles deep, never more than five or six. He takes this to mean the Moon has a hard floor beneath its surface, a hint that it may not be what it seems.
